Frozen estimator source: 15 least-squares exposure mappings, BIC margin 10 with BIC-weighted averaging, linear fallback guard at three times max(|est_lin|, se_lin), HC1 delta-method intervals widened by departure from linear, count mapping capped at 3x the 99.5th percentile, no resampling, design and cluster labels unused

claims.claim: Library contains a sigmoid mapping centred at 0.5 with scale 0.1, equal to the case-6 generating sigmoid (centre 0.5, steepness 10) up to the absorbed coefficient; case-6 final error is 0.198

Evaluator definitions: relative error capped at 2, per-case RMSE then unweighted mean over 8 cases, width cap 4, bias as mean over cases of absolute mean signed relative error; linear, oracle, DiM and HT baseline definitions; case specifications for the eight cases; final seeds 9001-9024 and selection seeds 101-108

Two alternative estimator classes: flexible ridge ensemble with cross-validation, extrapolation split and wild block bootstrap; linear estimate plus shrunk degree-stratified HT-type residual correction (descriptions from source docstrings and function names; per-case behaviour not inspected)
